Module.Name: pi-review
Module.Description: Patient Identity Conflict Review Assistant. An InterSystems IRIS interoperability production in which an AI Hub agent investigates synthetic patient identity conflicts, gathers case-scoped source evidence through native MCP tools and a governance knowledge base, and recommends a route for human review. The reviewer keeps control of identity mappings; the agent cannot approve a merge.
Module.AfterInstallMessage:
PI Review classes, web assets and synthetic source fixtures are installed.
Prepare these host-side prerequisites before starting the application: - the local embedding model for the AI Hub governance knowledge base - named Docker volumes holding MCP bearer credentials and gateway TOML configuration - iris-mcp-server gateway containers sharing the IRIS network namespace - Config Store / Wallet model profile setup
After those prerequisites exist, start the dedicated USER installation with:
do ##class(PI.PackageSetup).Start()
For the complete host-side setup use the Docker Compose bootstrap documented in README.md.
Then open http://127.0.0.1:52784/identity/ and sign in with an IRIS administrator account holding %Admin_ConfigStore and %Admin_Wallet. Verify with scripts/test.sh.
Runtime web and source fixture paths resolve from the installed package resource root; the application does not require a /workspace source checkout after package installation.
